d:
Democrat James Talarico has won a crucial Senate race in Texas, marking a major setback for Republicans in this year's elections.
His victory over Republican Ken Paxton ends a 38-year Democratic drought in Texas Senate races. The last time a Democrat won a US Senate seat in the state was in 1988. The win also adds to Democratic gains across the country, strengthening the party's push for control of Congress.
A former schoolteacher, Talarico was relatively unknown until last year. He built his campaign around the rising cost of living under Republican leadership.
